headline: From JioStar to CleverTap: Ruchi Arya takes up senior director – HR role
summary: CleverTap has appointed Ruchi Arya as its new Senior Director of Human Resources, effective October 2026, to lead HR business partnering for its technology and product teams globally. Arya brings over 16 years of HR leadership experience from major media and tech firms, including senior roles at JioStar, Viacom18, and Network18. In her new role, she will oversee global HR programs, strategic workforce planning, and organizational development initiatives.

headline: Soniya Dave takes charge as CHRO at Ganesh Green Bharat
summary: Ganesh Green Bharat has appointed Soniya Dave as its Chief Human Resources Officer to lead its strategic HR, organizational development, and talent management initiatives. Dave brings over 22 years of experience, having previously held senior HR leadership positions at companies such as Nebula Infraspace, Shubham Group, and Unique Group. She holds a Bachelor of Commerce degree and an MBA.

headline: Apple bars employees from using confidential information in prediction markets
summary: Apple has updated its internal policies to explicitly prohibit current and former employees from using non-public company information to participate in prediction markets. The restriction covers confidential data regarding Apple as well as its suppliers, vendors, and business partners. This policy applies even to transactions that do not legally qualify as traditional insider trading under current securities laws.

headline: Fiserv cuts 3,000 employee and contractor roles under new CEO
summary: Payments technology firm Fiserv has reduced its workforce by 3,000 employees and contractors as part of a broader restructuring initiative under new CEO Takis Georgakopoulos. The company raised its cost-savings target to $1 billion under 'Project Elevate,' which also involves exiting non-core products and cutting senior management by over 10 percent. The operational changes follow pressure from activist investor Jana Partners to improve overall efficiency.

headline: UPL shifts roles to global services centres as employee costs decline 15%
summary: Agrochemicals firm UPL reduced its employee-related expenses by 15% year-on-year in Q2 FY27 by relocating roles from higher-cost geographies to its Global Business Services (GBS) centers in Pune, Mauritius, and Colombia. The company has nearly tripled its GBS workforce over the past two years as part of a broader operating model shift aimed at cost optimization and strengthening internal controls. While favorable foreign exchange movements also contributed to the decline, UPL plans to continue pursuing operational efficiencies.

headline: Squarespace to cut 19% of workforce
summary: Squarespace is eliminating approximately 300 positions, representing 19% of its global workforce, with the deepest cuts hitting product and engineering teams. CEO Anthony Casalena indicated the restructuring aims to flatten organizational layers, empower smaller teams, and increase operational agility amid broader tech shifts toward AI-driven website creation. Affected employees will receive severance packages including a minimum of 16 weeks of base pay, extended medical benefits, and career transition support.

headline: Cyient DLM ropes in Sandip Mishra as SVP and CHRO
summary: Cyient DLM has appointed Sandip Mishra as its new Senior Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer. Bringing over 29 years of HR leadership experience from major organizations including Prodapt, Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, Novartis, and Oracle, Mishra will oversee people strategy and culture-building. His deep expertise in talent strategy and organizational transformation is set to support Cyient DLM through its next phase of enterprise growth.

headline: Mrs Bectors Food Specialities appoints Saurabh Sharma as CHRO
summary: Mrs Bectors Food Specialities has appointed Saurabh Sharma as its new Chief Human Resources Officer. Sharma brings over 23 years of experience in human resources strategy and organizational development, having previously held leadership roles at Zydus Wellness, Bunge, and Sun Pharma. In his new role, he will focus on enhancing organizational capabilities, building a performance-driven culture, and supporting the company's business growth.

headline: Will Canva let go 1,271 from its workforce?
summary: Canva is restructuring its global workforce, impacting roughly 1,271 employees—about 22 percent of its staff—through layoffs, role transitions, and relocations. The Sydney-based design platform is making these major changes to adapt to its first growth slowdown in 13 years and to better position itself in an AI-driven software market. As part of the overhaul, Canva is consolidating product teams at its Sydney hub and introducing a mandatory multi-day in-office policy starting in January.
